shots.action: 高山湖远景，近处岩石上坐着小小的白绮玩偶；镜头缓慢后移，云影持续掠过湖面，空间越来越开阔。
shots.soundDescription: 高处风声、水声，音乐保留长线条。
shots.prompt: One uninterrupted ten-second realistic autumn travel shot at the ordinary overcast alpine lake of <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> defines the complete original location, single small fabric doll on the foreground rock, dark backpack and its badge. <Picture 2> defines the same doll design only, not another object. Begin with the pictured foreground doll and backpack and gently move the camera backward for the entire ten seconds, smoothly revealing more lake and mountain space. Keep natural slow cloud shadows and subtle water ripples. The doll is an inert sewn object: preserve its original open violet-pink eyes, thin round gold glasses, fixed facial proportions, pale bob hair and white/deep-violet/gold costume; no expression or pose change. The badge illustration also remains identical and fixed. Maintain ordinary grey weather, patchy snow, dry mountain slopes and physical contact shadows. Preserve the original exact object count and empty landscape. No person, body part, human face or reflection anywhere. No added doll, animal, flower, cut, new scene, rapid movement, readable letters, subtitle, credits, speech, singing, humming or voice.
